# Revoke Certificate

## Summary
issued → revoked with a written reason; number stays burned.

## Refuses when
no reason; already revoked.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.

## Example
The linked certificate is the kind of record this command revokes.

## Example
The linked certificate is an issued one; revoking it keeps its number and stamps the face as revoked.
attributes.cardDescription: Revokes an issued certificate with a written reason, keeping its number.
